items.h: 李强对推进农田水利和高标准农田建设作出重要批示强调 充分发挥高标准农田综合效益 为守牢粮食安全底线建设农业强国提供坚实支撑
items.summary: 新华社北京11月13日电 11月13日，国务院召开全国冬春农田水利暨高标准农田建设视频会议。中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李强日前对推进农田水利和高标准农田建设作出重要批示。批示指出：农田水利和高标准农田建设是夯实国家粮食安全根基的重要抓手。近年来，各地区各有关部门持续加强农田建设，为巩固提升粮食综合生产能力、增强农业防灾减灾能力发挥了关键作用。要坚持以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，深入贯彻落实党中央决策部署，坚持质量优先，扎实推进高标准农田建设和大中型灌区现代化改造，做好农田沟渠疏浚，促进农业节水增效，进一步筑牢农业防灾减灾基础。要抓好高标准农田建设突出问题整治，严格资金监管和项目管理，完善工程质量监督检验体系，强化设施运营管护，充分发挥综合效益，为守牢粮食安全底线、加快建设农业强国提供坚实支撑。

items.h: Two skulls likely belonging to enslaved people returned to Brazil after Harvard used them in eugenics studies
items.summary: Remains believed to have belonged to Africans or Afro-Brazilians repatriated after being flown back by diplomats Two skulls, including that of a man believed to have taken part in Brazil’s greatest slave revolt but whose remains were taken to the United States and used in racist eugenics studies at Harvard University, were repatriated on Wednesday. The remains had been outside Brazil since the 19th century. One was taken about 190 years ago from Salvador, the capital of the state of Bahia; the other, about 160 years ago, from Rio de Janeiro – and were welcomed back in moving, subdued ceremonies in both cities. Continue reading...

items.h: Ex-member of radical Marxist group scales balcony, escapes house arrest in Argentina
items.summary: Leonardo Bertulazzi, 74, awaiting extradition to Italy, reportedly used harness to flee custody A 74-year-old former member of Italy ’s radical Marxist group the Red Brigades has escaped from house arrest in Argentina , the country’s security ministry confirmed on Wednesday, after he reportedly hid his ankle monitor inside a tube of pork and lowered himself from a fifth-floor balcony. Authorities placed Leonardo Bertulazzi under house arrest in Buenos Aires in 2024, prior to his extradition to Italy to serve a 27-year prison sentence. He had received the sentence in 1987 for joining a subversive association and belonging to an armed group. Continue reading...

items.h: UK ministers told not to engage formally with Indian mega-zoo after lobbying

This week, the UK heads a 32-country committee meeting in Geneva of Cites, the United Nations body that regulates trade in endangered species. The meeting will examine how India has responded to compliance concerns about imports of endangered animals.
